description: The ready WakeHuBERT 'hey stemcom' model at its own calibrated default threshold (0.28).
notes: models.json at 2ac92d3b: featurizer wakehubert-int8. Threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per models.json: synthetic only: a Dutch edge-tts voice grid (nl-NL and nl-BE), voice-converted copies of edge-tts clips, OmniVoice clips, each checked against a speech recogniser transcript, with one held-out edge-tts test voice excluded; LibriSpeech train-clean-100 (CC BY 4.0) mixed in as background babble; negatives from wakeforge datasets/train.csv and the even half of an AudioSet noise sample.
